title: Profile & preferences
description: How you appear to others, how the platform looks for you, and how your account is secured.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your display name is shown across the platform, for example in the people directory and audit log.
profile.managedHint: Email, username and department are managed by your organisation. Contact IT support to change them.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: These follow you to every device you sign in on.

language.label: Language
language.hint: Used for menus, messages and emails.

theme.hint: System follows your device's light or dark setting.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.hint: Dates and times are shown in this time zone.

password.title: Password
password.description: Change the password you use to sign in with your local account.
password.signOutNote: Your other sessions will be signed out.
password.changed: Password changed. Your other sessions were signed out.
password.mustChange: Your administrator asked you to choose a new password.

rules.label: Password requirements
rules.variety: Not too repetitive (at least 5 different characters)

external.title: You sign in through your organisation
external.body: Your password is managed by your organisation's identity provider. Change it there, or contact IT support.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Devices and browsers that are signed in to your account. Sign out any you don't recognise.
sessions.revokeOthersBody: {count, plural, one {# other session will be signed out. This device stays signed in.} other {# other sessions will be signed out. This device stays signed in.}}
sessions.revokedOthers: {count, plural, one {# session signed out} other {# sessions signed out}}

access.title: My access
access.description: Roles you hold and how you got them. Ask an administrator if something is missing.
access.summary: {roles, plural, one {# role} other {# roles}} · {permissions, plural, one {# permission} other {# permissions}}
access.none: You don't have any roles yet.

validation.format: This doesn't have the expected format.
